papers_read.title_as_printed: Explainable Machine Learning with Pairwise Interactions for Predicting Conversion from Mild Cognitive Impairment to Alzheimer's Disease Utilizing Multi-Modalities Data (Cai et al.; Brain Sci. 2023, 13, 1535)
Predicting Conversion from MCI to AD Combining Multi-Modality Data and Based on Molecular Subtype (Li, Yuan, Wu, Gu, Sun; Brain Sci. 2021, 11, 674)

what_each_reports.P-211: ADNI 1/2/3/GO amnestic MCI (1042 at baseline); Explainable Boosting Machine on tabular features (FreeSurfer regional volumes/thickness, ADAS13, MMSE, FAQ, CDR-SB, demographics, baseline EMCI/LMCI, APOE4); 5-fold CV. Five-year conversion: accuracy 85%, AUC 0.92 (MRI + cognitive scores; 225 participants remaining). Three-year comb-a model with interactions: accuracy 0.75, AUC 0.81 (test data).
what_each_reports.P-179: ADNI-1 (125 MCI) for training/internal validation and ADNI-GO/2 (98 MCI) as external test; conversion to AD within three years; FreeSurfer ROI volumes plus peripheral-blood SNP genotypes and mRNA expression; molecular subtyping (SNF + label propagation), Lasso feature selection, variational Bayes multiple-kernel classifier. Internal 5-fold CV: AUC 0.826 (acc 79.20%); no-subtyping classifier AUC 0.785; external ADNI-GO/2 test AUC 0.781.

quantity_a: AUC for MCI-to-AD conversion within 5 years, ADNI amnestic MCI, cognitive scores + regional MRI volumes + demographics/APOE4, 5-fold CV.
quantity_b: AUC for MCI-to-AD conversion within 3 years, ADNI-1 MCI (n=125), regional MRI volumes + blood SNP + blood mRNA expression with molecular subtyping, 5-fold CV (external ADNI-GO/2 AUC 0.78).
incompatible_if_same: No. At the matched three-year horizon P-211 reports AUC 0.81, against P-179's 0.83 internal and 0.78 external; these overlap. Neither paper evaluates the other's model or claims an ordering the other refutes.

gates.task: match in label (T2) but the horizons differ (5 years vs 3 years)
gates.dataset_family: match: both ADNI (P-211 ADNI 1/2/3/GO; P-179 ADNI-1 with ADNI-GO/2 external)
gates.validation_tier: match for the compared figures (both internal 5-fold CV); P-179 additionally reports a temporally/phase-separate ADNI-GO/2 test
gates.modality_family: mismatch: P-211 combines neuropsychological scores and APOE4 with MRI volumes; P-179 combines MRI volumes with blood genomics and transcriptomics (no cognitive scores); the record sets modality_family_equal 'No'

endpoint_and_metric: incompatible: same metric type (ROC AUC) but different horizons (5-year vs 3-year conversion) and different predictor sets (cognitive scores vs blood omics alongside MRI).
performance_validity: flag does not apply: 0.92 and 0.83 are below 0.97.
independence: Distinct author groups (Xi'an Jiaotong vs Southeast University Nanjing); both draw on ADNI MCI participants and may overlap.
grounds: P-211's AUC 0.92 is for conversion within five years, whereas P-179's AUC 0.83 is for conversion within three years.
P-211 predicts from cognitive scores, demographics, APOE4 and MRI volumes, whereas P-179 predicts from MRI volumes plus blood SNP and mRNA data, so the predictor sets differ.
At the matched three-year horizon P-211 reports AUC 0.81, which sits with P-179's 0.83 (internal) and 0.78 (external), so no disagreement survives alignment.

evidence_quotes.quote: The five-years prediction accuracy reached 85% (AUC = 0.92) using both cognitive scores and MRI markers.
The main performance indicators, accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and AUC, were 0.75, 0.78, 0.73, and 0.81 (with interaction effects)
we propose a subtyping-based prediction strategy to predict the conversion from MCI to AD in three years according to MCI patient subtypes.
In internal fivefold cross-validation within ADNI-1, we achieved an overall AUC of 0.83 (79.20% accuracy, 81.25% sensitivity, 77.92% specificity)
In external validation using ADNI-1 as a training set and ADNI-GO/2 as an independent test set, we attained an AUC of 0.78

record_defects: claim_a 'AUC 0.92 on T2' omits that 0.92 is the five-year horizon; the three-year AUC in P-211 is 0.81.
Registry Sample_N_Approx '242804' for P-211 is impossible (1042 MCI participants).

P-179's own text is internally inconsistent (Section 3.2 gives MCI-CPS 5-fold 80.00% accuracy with 81.82%/77.08% sens/spec; Table 1 and the abstract give 79.20%/81.25%/77.92%); the AUC 0.826 is consistent.
resolution_note says 'Confirmed genuine' while resolution says 'Rejected: Task, dataset, or modality mismatch' and the status is partially_resolved_candidate: internally inconsistent.
what_would_change_the_verdict: A three-year P-211 AUC with a matched predictor set whose uncertainty excluded P-179's 0.83; P-211's own three-year figure (0.81) does not.
